description: Ocular-dominance critical period of primary visual cortex: opening when parvalbumin-cell inhibition matures, closing with perineuronal-net condensation; enzymatic removal of the nets reopens it. Ages for choosing the gate's schedule positions and thresholds; the stage itself takes only Params.
reopening: chondroitinase ABC degrades perineuronal nets and restores ocular-dominance plasticity in adults (Pizzorusso et al. 2002): critical_period_gate with reopen = true
